why_tests_missed_it: The original authorized-session ContractValidationOnly emitted a static ordered-step declaration and existing tests asserted only that JSON shape. It did not inspect cmdlet metadata, controller AST, generated recovery AST, identity failure cases, pipeline WhatIf binding, or watchdog polling.

hotfix.isolation: Resolve exact ifIndex plus Name/InterfaceDescription/MacAddress snapshot, then pipe resolved object to Disable-NetAdapter.
hotfix.watchdog_recovery: Generated PowerShell 5.1 script resolves exact identity through Get-NetAdapter -IncludeHidden and pipes the resolved object to Enable-NetAdapter.
hotfix.finally_restoration: Only successfully disabled identity snapshots are restored; failure retains watchdog and blocks PASS.
hotfix.watchdog_readback: Creation and deletion use bounded polling; timeout blocks PASS.
